mapper.select: SELECT * FROM com_contract_receivable WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND source_system='DPPMS' AND source_row_id=#{query.sourceRowId} AND source_revision_hash=#{query.sourceRevisionHash} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.* FROM com_contract_receivable r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.deleted=0 AND r.source_system='DPPMS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_history h WHERE h.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND h.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND h.deleted=0 AND h.source_system='DPPMS' AND CAST(h.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(r.contract_no AS BINARY)) ORDER BY r.source_row_id,r.source_revision_hash,r.id LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_contract_receivable r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.deleted=0 AND r.source_system='DPPMS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_history h WHERE h.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND h.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND h.deleted=0 AND h.source_system='DPPMS' AND CAST(h.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(r.contract_no AS BINARY))
